name: @belal-elsabbagh-apex/copilot-mcp
description: MCP server exposing EHR Copilot tools: prod->pre-prod order clone, queue-item build, and UiPath Orchestrator execution analysis
author: Belal Elsabbagh

scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts --target node --format esm --minify --outfile dist/server.js && chmod +x dist/server.js
scripts.mcpb:pack: bun run build && rm -rf .mcpb-stage copilot-mcp.mcpb && mkdir -p .mcpb-stage/dist && cp manifest.json copilot-mcp.config.example.json .mcpb-stage/ && cp dist/server.js .mcpb-stage/dist/server.js && bunx mcpb pack .mcpb-stage copilot-mcp.mcpb && rm -rf .mcpb-stage
scripts.prepare: lefthook install || true; bun run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
